crossRefs.note: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron.…

people.name: Adithaim
people.line: A town in the Shephelah region of Judah.

people.name: Gederah
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Baal-hanan and Jozabad

people.name: Gederothaim
people.line: Town in Judah; mentioned in list of allotted cities

people.name: Shaaraim
people.line: Town in Judah; site of Philistine retreat

translations.web: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen cities, along with their villages.
translations.kjv: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
translations.asv: and Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages.
